display_name: 源训练合并非有限检查对照
description: 固定源数据、模型、随机数与预算，比较原检查和合并检查的训练轨迹及耗时。

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 32768 source fit IDs x three views, received/anchor/innovation/variance/clean IQ

permissions.claim_scope: Source training trajectory equality and local measured time only; no target predictions

checkpoint.initialization: Existing legal source masked prior and recreated DURA correction initial state
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA provenance, prior commit and exact ordered 32768 source IDs; no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both prior and source context are F/TX/V/target-free source only
checkpoint.selection_rule: Two paired five-epoch trajectories, alternating order after warmup; no target and no weights saved

expected_artifacts: result.json: two paired source trajectory equalities and optimization times

rows.method: Separate versus combined finite checks and equal gradient clipping
rows.purpose: Evaluate fewer GPU synchronization checks without optimizer updates on nonfinite inputs
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110612, order 2026110613, mask 2026110711, fixed source prior 2026110707
rows.scenario: 64 fixed source training IDs, three source simulation views
expected_artifacts: result.json: two paired source trajectory equalities and optimization times

notes: For finite data both paths must match every step loss and final parameter bitwise; technical failure prevents output.
On nonfinite loss the fused path backpropagates and clips first but checks and fails before optimizer.step; unit tests cover finite-loss infinite-gradient.
Warmup and two paired orders on a shared local GPU; not [计算环境] performance or target prediction parity.
Source prior real checkpoint, source DURA context and source initialization only; no F/TX/V/target.
